subject: Arte
description_pt: Analisar os elementos constitutivos das artes visuais (ponto, linha, forma, direção, cor, tom, escala, dimensão, espaço, movimento etc.) na apreciação de diferentes produções artísticas.

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos constituintes das artes visuais — ponto, linha, forma, cor, tom, escala, espaço e movimento — em obras de arte
components.description_en: Identify constituent elements of visual arts — point, line, shape, color, tone, scale, space, and movement — in artworks

components.description_pt: Analisar como elementos visuais funcionam e interagem em diferentes obras artísticas
components.description_en: Analyze how visual elements function and interact within different artistic works
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how visual or multimedia elements establish or reinforce the tone of a literary text

components.description_pt: Avaliar o uso de elementos visuais constituintes na apreciação de diversas obras de arte
components.description_en: Evaluate the use of visual constituent elements in the appreciation of diverse artworks
components.cc_component_description: Identify how visual elements in a digital or print text enhance understanding of the narrative

cc_matches.description: Use information gained from the illustrations and words in a print or digital text to demonstrate understanding of its characters, setting, or plot.
Analyze how visual and multimedia elements contribute to the meaning, tone, or beauty of a text (e.g., graphic novel, multimedia presentation of fiction, folktale, myth, poem).
